excerpt: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy block creators in dozens of countries. Here is the sovereign infrastructure that works everywhere they do not.

imageCaption: Sovereign infrastructure routes around Stripe and PayPal restrictions permanently — not a workaround, a different architecture.

content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are well-known platforms for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-20|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-what-actually-how-10|Selling Courses]]-digital-products-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-15|selling]] digital products, but they often come with significant restrictions, especially for creators in certain countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure providers like COREMERCH offer a range of tools and services that enable creators to build and deploy their own online stores, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have strict guidelines and restrictions for creators in certain countries, which can result in account suspensions or even fund holds of up to 180 days with no appeal. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be accessible to creators worldwide, regardless of their location, and provides a permanent structural alternative to these restricted platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to restricted payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If you're a digital creator in a restricted country, the best alternative to Stripe or Gumroad is to build your own sovereign commerce infrastructure using a provider like COREMERCH, which offers a range of tools and services to help you deploy a custom online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a flat 0.5% fee.

For creators who want to get started quickly, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a great option, providing a fully deployed online store with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing, all within 48 hours. You can learn more about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, then select a backend logic provider like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and finally, set up a payment processing system like NOWPayments. With these components in place, you can deploy your online store and start selling digital products to a global audience.
